clouds.prompt: Image 1 is a reference crop of the sky from a hand-painted cartoon point-and-click adventure game background. Paint ONE new cloud in exactly the same style as the two small clouds in image 1: creamy off-white puffs, soft pale grey-blue shading on the underside, subtle warm highlights, gentle painterly edges, no hard black outline. Return only the single cloud, complete and uncropped, centered with generous empty margin, on a genuinely transparent background. No blue sky, no other objects, no trees, no birds, no text, no checkerboard, no shadow on the ground. Cloud shape: a small, wide, flat-bottomed fair-weather cumulus cloud with three soft rounded puffs, about three times wider than tall.

skyMask.method: 4-connected flood fill from the top edge through sky-blue (b>=150, b-r>=60, b-g>=30) and pale cloud pixels (min>=165, max-min<=50); enclosed specks up to 200 px filled; alpha blurred sigma 0.6
